name: Drive Password
description_en:
Drive Password is a product in the Password management category. Its directory profile covers Password Generator, Secure Password Sharing, Multifactor Authentication, Single Sign-On (SSO), Backup/Restore, Password Encryption, Mobiles Password Management, Websites Password Management.

Deployment is listed as Browser Based (Cloud) Mobile App (Android, iOS). The listed organization sizes are All (Small, Medium, Large) Freelancers Individuals. API support is listed as NA. Support channels are listed as Online.

The directory's pricing snapshot states: Free Trial Available Starts at $4.99. Offers Free-forever plan.. This is a dated third-party reference; current amounts, billing periods, trial conditions and regional availability require an official pricing check.

Typical evaluation tasks associated with these feature labels include: create passwords using configured requirements; use a shared identity provider for application sign-in. These are workflow suggestions based on the reported capabilities, rather than evidence of actual customer adoption.
